Sebastian Fundora vs Ermal Hadribeaj

WBC Super Welterweight World Champion Sebastian “The Towering Inferno” Fundora will bring his can’t-miss, all-action style to the ring against unbeaten mandatory challenger Ermal Hadribeaj.

Brandon Figueroa vs Tomoki Kameda

Two-division champion and reigning WBA Featherweight World Champion Brandon “The Heartbreaker” Figueroa makes the first defense of his title against Japanese star and former world champion Tomoki Kameda in the co-main event.

Jermall Charlo vs Koen Mazoudier

Undefeated two-division world champion Jermall Charlo steps in to face Australia’s Koen Mazoudier in a 10-round super middleweight showdown.
